output.reason: [ev-6536d2775265] says #22354 reverts commit 43e594104212 because of suspected race conditions in CI, and changes only controller/appcontroller.go [ev-06d8252d5ef8]. [ev-e8aa9d340122] and [ev-491b23d3fbe4] name the subject: the application controller's shard initialization order. The reverted fix moved shard setup to before the app informer starts; without it, every application is first assigned to shard 0, and application-controller-0 can stop syncing applications. The original fix is listed in the same 3.0.0 changelog section [ev-8102a79a3745], so the fix and its revert likely cancel out within this release: sharded controllers keep the same initial-sharding race as before, with nothing new to act on. That last point is my inference from the changelog, not something the evidence states, which is why confidence is low.
